name: BLEURT
description: Text generation has made significant advances in the last few years. Yet, evaluation metrics have lagged behind, as the most popular choices (e.g., BLEU and ROUGE) may correlate poorly with human judgments. We propose BLEURT, a learned evaluation metric based on BERT that can model human judgments with a few thousand possibly biased training examples.
evaluation_method: correlation with human judgments / learned regression score
typical_sota_score: 0.6–0.9 (Pearson/Spearman correlation with human judgments, varies by dataset and BLEURT version)
reputation: Widely adopted as a learned text-generation evaluation metric and a common alternative to BLEU/ROUGE in the NLP community.
notes: Metric rather than a task benchmark; scores are typically reported as correlation with human ratings, and absolute values depend on the evaluation setup and reference data.
